Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::chooseOneForReview(requestid:Integer): LoanRequest {
          definition:
          currentLoanRequest:LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequests->select(o | o.RequestID = requestid)->any()
            
            precondition:
          CurrentLoanRequests->size() <> 0 and currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false
            
            postcondition:
          LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(currentLoanRequest) and result = currentLoanRequest
            
        }
